tags.name: catalog-management
tags.description: Authenticated catalog authoring and Storefront publication: products, variants, prices, media, and publish/unpublish.

tags.name: storefront
tags.description: Public, unauthenticated Storefront catalog: published products only.

tags.name: inventory
tags.description: Inventory balances (read) and management write operations: receive, adjust, transfer.

tags.name: suppliers
tags.description: Tenant-owned supplier management and canonical receiving history.

tags.name: staff
tags.description: Tenant staff (membership) management: list/detail, lifecycle, and role/scope assignment over the existing identity + RBAC model. Not an HR/payroll domain.

tags.name: pos
tags.description: Authorized register context and atomic POS checkout.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward cursor; invalid cursors fail closed. Stable UUID ascending order.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring in name or code.

post.summary: createSupplier
post.description: Requires a tenant-wide suppliers.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Exact replay returns the original response; changed intent conflicts.

patch.description: Requires a tenant-wide suppliers.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Exact replay returns the original response; changed intent conflicts. PATCH status active/inactive implements activation/deactivation. Nullable optional fields may be cleared with null. No DELETE exists.

get.description: Requires a tenant-wide suppliers.read grant. Also requires inventory.read; results include only operations entirely within the caller's inventory location visibility. Supplier name/code are immutable receipt snapshots; product/location display names are current.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward cursor; invalid cursors fail closed. Stable UUID ascending order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per page (1-100, default 25).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring in identity display name or email.

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: Filter to memberships currently assigned this role.

post.summary: createStaff
post.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Creates an active membership for an already-provisioned identity; there is no invitation delivery. Exact replay returns the original response; changed intent conflicts.

patch.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Transitions membership lifecycle (activate/suspend/revoke). Revoked (deactivated) is terminal. The last active staff.manage membership cannot be suspended or revoked.

post.summary: assignStaffRole
post.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Assigns an existing tenant role + access scope to the membership. Anti-escalation: the role's permission set must be a subset of the caller's own current tenant-wide permissions.

requestBody.description: Role and access scope to assign.

delete.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Revokes an active assignment (history-preserving; never deleted). Cannot strand the tenant's last active staff.manage membership.

post.summary: Accept received merchandise and initiate its server-calculated refund.
Attest an actual manual cash refund. Electronic settlement is not supported.
Place a guest online order with authoritative pricing and stock reservations.
post.description: Public configured tenant/brand context. Requires a stable Idempotency-Key. COD is enabled only by server-owned routing configuration; payment stays pending. PRICE_CHANGED returns the current total in error.details[0].value before business mutation. Exact replay returns the original placement result, not live order status.

get.summary: List the caller's own selectable active tenants.
get.description: Identity-scoped bootstrap. Requires only a valid session (no X-Tenant-Id) and returns solely the verified caller's own active memberships against active tenants.

200.description: The caller's active memberships and selectable tenants.

get.summary: Read the caller's effective read capability for a tenant.
List products in the caller's catalog read scope.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant brand.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Restrict to a product status.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per page (1-100, default 25).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

post.summary: Create a product in a brand.
post.description: Creates a draft product in the target brand. Requires catalog.author over the brand and a required Idempotency-Key header; a replay with the same key and body returns the original product, and the same key with a different body is a 409.

200.description: The created product identity and lifecycle state.

patch.description: Replaces the product's name, slug, style code, and description. Requires catalog.author over the product's brand and a required Idempotency-Key header.

post.summary: Change a product's internal lifecycle status.
post.description: Activates, deactivates (active to draft), or archives a product. A published product cannot be deactivated (unpublish first); archiving force-unpublishes. Requires catalog.author over the product's brand and a required Idempotency-Key header.

200.description: The product's new lifecycle and publication state.

post.summary: Publish a product to the Storefront.
post.description: Publishes an active product that has at least one active, priced variant. Requires the distinct catalog.publish permission over the product's brand and a required Idempotency-Key header. A structurally unsellable product is a 422.

delete.summary: Unpublish a product from the Storefront.
delete.description: Removes a product from the public Storefront while leaving its canonical catalog state intact. Requires catalog.publish over the product's brand and a required Idempotency-Key header.

post.summary: Create a variant under a product.
post.description: Creates an active variant with a unique SKU. Requires catalog.author over the product's brand and a required Idempotency-Key header; a duplicate SKU is a 409.

put.summary: Set a variant's active base price for a currency.
put.description: Writes a new active price in minor units and archives the prior active price for that currency (history retained). Requires catalog.author over the variant's brand and a required Idempotency-Key header.

post.summary: Authorize a product media upload and get a server-controlled destination.
post.description: Returns a tenant/product-scoped storage bucket and path (and a signed upload URL when object storage is reachable). The client can never choose an arbitrary destination. Requires catalog.author over the product's brand. This is not a durable mutation and requires no Idempotency-Key.

requestBody.description: The intended content type and optional variant/file name.

post.summary: Register a product media reference.
post.description: Records an object-storage reference (never a binary) for a product, optionally scoped to a variant, optionally marked primary. Requires catalog.author over the product's brand and a required Idempotency-Key header.

delete.description: Soft-archives a media reference (never a hard delete). Requires catalog.author over the media's brand and a required Idempotency-Key header.

get.summary: List published products for a storefront tenant.
get.description: Public, unauthenticated. Returns only published, publicly sellable products for the given tenant (optionally narrowed to a brand). No internal lifecycle, cost, exact stock, or unpublished data is ever returned.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant the storefront serves.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant brand.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum products (1-200, default 50).

get.summary: Read a single published product by slug.
get.description: Public, unauthenticated. Returns the published product for the given tenant and slug, or 404 if it is missing or unpublished.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant the storefront serves.

get.summary: List inventory balances in the caller's inventory read scope.

parameters.name: inventoryLocationId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant inventory location.

parameters.name: variantId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single variant.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per page (1-100, default 25).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

post.summary: Receive stock into an inventory location.
post.description: Records received stock at a single in-tenant inventory location. Requires the inventory.receive permission over the target location and a required Idempotency-Key header; a replay with the same key and body is not applied twice, and the same key with a different body is a 409.

200.description: The recorded receipt and observed post-commit balance.

post.summary: Reconcile an inventory count to a physically observed on-hand.
post.description: Reconciles the balance at a single in-tenant inventory location to a counted on-hand, guarded by the version it was counted against (optimistic concurrency). Requires the inventory.adjust permission over the target location and a required Idempotency-Key header. A stale expectedVersion is a 409; a same-key/different-body replay is a 409.

200.description: The authoritative before/after balance for the reconciliation.

post.summary: Transfer stock between two inventory locations.
post.description: Atomically moves stock from a source to a destination inventory location. Requires the inventory.transfer permission over BOTH the source and the destination location and a required Idempotency-Key header. Insufficient source stock is a 409; a same-key/different-body replay is a 409.

200.description: The recorded transfer and observed post-commit balances of both sides.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant brand.

parameters.name: branchId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant branch.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Restrict to an order status.

parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

get.summary: Read a single order's detail and fulfillment progress.

200.description: The order detail with embedded fulfillment progress.

get.summary: List active registers the caller is fully authorized to sell from.

200.description: The caller's server-derived register selling contexts.

post.summary: Atomically complete a cash POS sale.
post.description: Creates one canonical POS Order, captured cash Payment, full Fulfillment, and inventory issue in one transaction. Currency, branch, and location are derived from the Register. A stale expectedTotalMinor returns PRICE_CHANGED before mutation. One Idempotency-Key protects the complete sale intent.

requestBody.description: Register, expected total, received cash, and variant quantities.

200.description: The completed atomic sale and its canonical components.

post.summary: Enroll and activate an offline-capable POS device.
post.description: An authorized human binds a locally generated Ed25519 public key and installation to one tenant register. Private keys are never accepted.

post.summary: Rotate an active POS device public key.

requestBody.description: Replacement public key and register authorization context.

post.summary: Revoke a POS device and its current credential.

requestBody.description: Revocation reason and register authorization context.

post.summary: Issue a bounded immutable offline grant and complete catalog snapshot.
post.description: Requires a normal authorized human session. No policy means offline selling is disabled. At most one device may hold active authority per inventory location.

200.description: The grant and exact price snapshot.

post.summary: Ingest a cash sale already accepted offline.
post.description: Device-authenticated ingestion verifies canonical Ed25519 intent and historical grant prices. It returns synced when stock can be issued, otherwise persists the order/payment and a governed reconciliation. Idempotency records are retained indefinitely (minimum guaranteed queue window: 365 days).

clerkSessionToken.description: Clerk session token presented as a Bearer credential.

TenantIdHeader.name: X-Tenant-Id
TenantIdHeader.description: The tenant the request operates within.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Caller-stable idempotency key for the write. A replay with the same key and body is not applied twice; the same key with a different body is rejected with a 409.

Error409.description: The request conflicts with current state.
